title: Switch AI engine from OpenRouter to Google Gemini

requirements.summary: Replace OpenRouter AI engine with Google Gemini API in aiEngine.ts, preserving message history and error handling
acceptanceCriteria: Sending a text message in the AI Guru chat triggers a request to the Gemini API endpoint, not OpenRouter.
The response from Gemini is displayed correctly in the chat UI.
If no API key is stored, the user is prompted to enter their Gemini API key.
The stored API key is used for all subsequent requests.

file_operations.description: Replace the OpenRouter text chat implementation with Google Gemini API. Update the sendMessage function to call the Gemini REST endpoint (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent) using the stored Gemini API key. Preserve the existing message history array handling, error handling patterns, and the helper functions getStoredApiKey() and setStoredApiKey(). Keep the Pollinations.ai image generation logic unchanged. Update the isImageRequest function if needed to ensure Hindi keywords still trigger image generation.

requirements.summary: Update API key configuration UI in AIGuru.tsx to reference Google Gemini instead of OpenRouter
acceptanceCriteria: The API key input panel shows 'Google Gemini API Key' as the label.
A help link or instruction text points users to https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey.
No mention of OpenRouter remains in the UI.

file_operations.description: Update all API key configuration UI elements to reference 'Google Gemini API Key' instead of 'OpenRouter'. Change input labels, placeholder text, and help copy to direct users to https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey to obtain a free Gemini API key. Remove any OpenRouter-specific instructions or links. Ensure the API key state management (useState, localStorage interaction) continues to work with the updated labels.

requirements.summary: Update .env.example and code comments to reflect Google Gemini API usage
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/.env.example references Gemini, not OpenRouter or OpenAI.
No stale references to OpenRouter API keys remain in comments or documentation strings.

file_operations.description: Update the environment variable documentation to reference Google Gemini API instead of OpenRouter/OpenAI. Note that users obtain a free Gemini API key from Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey). Remove any references to VITE_OPENROUTER_API_KEY or similar OpenRouter-specific variables. Clarify that the API key is stored client-side in localStorage.

Update any inline comments or JSDoc documentation strings that reference OpenRouter or OpenAI to mention Google Gemini instead. Ensure function-level comments for sendMessage, getStoredApiKey, and setStoredApiKey reflect the Gemini API usage. Remove any stale references to OpenRouter endpoints or authentication patterns.
